Interpretation contract

  • Formation and pre-touch features existed before each original entry.
  • Touch-candle reclaim/rejection is excluded because using it requires a later, realistically priced entry.
  • Skipping a baseline trade can expose replacement signals; this screen intentionally does not model them.
  • Repeated trades and zones are correlated. Month-block intervals reduce, but do not eliminate, that dependence.
  • Phase 4 must re-simulate promising rules before any Pine implementation.
